title: ax-next chart values
description: Type-checks the chart's boolean flags so a QUOTED boolean fails the install loudly instead of silently flipping a capability on. Go templates treat any non-empty string as true, so `enabled: "false"` (or `--set-string enabled=false`) reads as OFF to the operator and renders as ON. Several of these flags are capability boundaries — the /api/workspace/* routes, /admin/credentials*, the Ingress, the TCP credential proxy — so the accident grants reach (CLAUDE.md invariant 5). Everything not listed here is deliberately unconstrained: this schema exists to close one failure mode, not to become a second copy of values.yaml. Adding a new boolean to values.yaml? Add it here too — __tests__/render.test.ts fails the build if you don't.

forcePathStyle.description: Path-style S3 addressing. Stamped straight onto AX_BLOB_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE as a string, so quoting it happens to survive — typed here anyway so the whole boolean surface is consistent.

enabled.description: Serve the channel-web SPA from the host pod.

agentWorkspace.description: CAPABILITY GATE. Off means the k8s preset never registers /api/workspace/* — the routes do not exist on the wire.

enabled.description: CAPABILITY GATE. Renders the credential-proxy TCP Service and the NetworkPolicy egress that reaches it.
Deploy the git-server storage tier (StatefulSet, Services, auth Secret, NetworkPolicy).
CAPABILITY GATE. Publishes an Ingress — this is what puts the host on the internet.

tls.description: Add the TLS block to the Ingress.

enabled.description: Render the GKE BackendConfig and bind the host Service to it.
Deploy the in-cluster dev MinIO (Deployment, Service, generated root password) and point the blob backend at it.

Run the bundled Bitnami PostgreSQL subchart. This one is schema-ONLY: it is also the subchart's `condition:` in Chart.yaml, and helm's condition resolver silently keeps a dependency ENABLED when the value is not a real bool — no template can intercept that.

readyTimeoutSeconds.description: How long the pg-init hook Job waits for the embedded postgres to accept connections before failing (TASK-563).

activeDeadlineSeconds.description: Job-wide deadline for the pg-init hook Job, across restarts. Must exceed readyTimeoutSeconds.

enabled.description: Take the database URL from an existing Secret instead of the subchart.
Allow dev-service sidecars in runner pods.

skipKubeVersionCheck.description: Bypass the 1.29+ SidecarContainers guard. A quoted value used to SKIP the safety check.

allowUserInstalled.description: CAPABILITY GATE. Ships the starter skill-creator skill, i.e. authoring capability.

preset.description: Which plugin assembly `serve` boots. 'memory' requires the memory.* block and renders its env/mounts/PVC.

vertexProject.description: Vertex AI project for the embeddings embed path. Required when host.preset=memory.
